regeneration.future_capture_requirements: A future epoch requires a newly reviewed plan, source/build/binary bindings, root GO receipt, and fresh non-existing packet/output paths; the frozen plan's capture_root points at retained evidence and must not be reused for overwrite.
regeneration.historical_capture_scope: The two capture commands above describe the completed epoch and its retained packet roots. They are provenance only; do not rerun them against those roots or treat them as a safe recapture recipe.

scope: All regular files and symlink entries under one completed epoch; raw reports remain external.
